incident_spec.summary: Concurrent UPDATE statements on a single row in a small table cause significant delays due to locking contention.
symptoms: UPDATE statements take minutes to complete
incident_spec.mechanism: High concurrency on a single row leads to lock contention, as PostgreSQL enforces row-level locks during updates. Without indexes, the table scan exacerbates contention.
